set system ldp session-protection hold-d.template: set system ldp session-protection hold-down-time [parameter1] hold-walk-count [parameter2]

parameters.name: hold-down-time
parameters.explanation: LDP会话保护的下行时间，单位为秒。

set routing-options autonomous-system <A.explanation: 配置路由选项中的自治系统号。

parameters.name: AS_NUMBER

parameters.name: router-id

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set forwarding-options ldp protocol labe.explanation: 配置转发选项中的LDP协议标签。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0.0

set protocols bfd template single-hop in.template: set protocols bfd template single-hop interval min-transmit [parameter1] min-receive [parameter2] multiplier [parameter3]
set protocols bfd template single-hop in.command: set protocols bfd template single-hop interval min-transmit 50 min-receive 50 multiplier 3
set protocols bfd template single-hop in.explanation: 配置BFD单跳模板的传输间隔、接收间隔和乘数。

parameters.name: min-transmit
parameters.explanation: 最小传输间隔，单位为毫秒。

parameters.name: min-receive
parameters.explanation: 最小接收间隔，单位为毫秒。

parameters.name: multiplier
parameters.explanation: 乘数，用于计算BFD会话的检测时间。

set protocols mpls ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1.template: set protocols mpls ldp neighbor [parameter1] target
set protocols mpls ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1.command: set protocols mpls ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1 target
set protocols mpls ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1.explanation: 配置MPLS LDP邻居的目标地址。

set protocols mpls ldp discovery targete.template: set protocols mpls ldp discovery targeted-hello receive enable
set protocols mpls ldp discovery targete.command: set protocols mpls ldp discovery targeted-hello receive enable
set protocols mpls ldp discovery targete.explanation: 启用MPLS LDP发现目标Hello接收功能。

set protocols mpls ldp discovery targete.template: set protocols mpls ldp discovery targeted-hello send enable
set protocols mpls ldp discovery targete.command: set protocols mpls ldp discovery targeted-hello send enable
set protocols mpls ldp discovery targete.explanation: 启用MPLS LDP发现目标Hello发送功能。

set security policies interzone <ZONE> f.template: set security policies interzone [parameter1] from-zone [parameter2] to-zone [parameter3] policy [parameter4] action [parameter5]
set security policies interzone <ZONE> f.command: set security policies interzone <ZONE> from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy allow-anything action permit
set security policies interzone <ZONE> f.explanation: 配置安全策略，允许从非信任区域到信任区域的任何流量。

set security ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1 passwo.template: set security ldp neighbor [parameter1] password key-chain [parameter2]
set security ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1 passwo.command: set security ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1 password key-chain 1
set security ldp neighbor 1.1.1.1 passwo.explanation: 配置LDP邻居的密码密钥链。
